test_item:
Verification of Project-Specific Critical Extension
(extension value is incorrect or the critical extension is missing; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. A leaf certificate without the NR1L project-specific critical extension is available (wrong-OID variant of X-e)
input: Leaf certificate whose CertificatePolicies OID differs from the project identifier, or which omits the critical extension
proc:
1. Read the certificate extensions of the wrong-OID certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Confirm the Cert Provider rejects the certificate and returns the error code
$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest
er:
1. The openssl output shows no `X509v3 Certificate Policies: critical` line, or a `Policy:` line whose OID differs from 1.3.6.1.4.1.57872.<…>
2. `$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest` contains an `ERR_` entry with the error code; the exact keyword is `PENDING: DR-SEC-h log keyword`
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: CertProfile r36; 037 SWE1-CertProvider-011 Verification Criteria (second WHEN/THEN pair)
Polarion: NRL-349394
ER 2 keyword pending DR-SEC-h
